paragraph: Today’s Granville composite registers at a cautiously constructive 56 out of 100 with zero breadth divergence warnings, pointing to a resilient underlying tape despite internal cross-currents. Participation remains healthy as equal-weight leadership outpaces the broader index with a 1.43% gain and transports flex a 1.01% advance, though this is offset by sharp weakness in bellwether semis dropping 1.69% and risk appetite plunging 1.83%. This internal tug-of-war unfolds against a tranquil macro backdrop characterized by a calm VIX at 17.03, stable high-yield spreads at 3.14%, and anchored 10-year real yields at 2.64%. The broader volatility complex remains supportive via a steep contango term structure that confirms a lack of systemic panic. Expect a choppy, selective session where sector rotation dictates direction, favoring a mildly defensive-leaning continuation of yesterday's range.
